spec: §15 suite G; §10: bennett_qreg_prepare and bennett_qreg_free require a clean register (E_QREG_NOT_CLEAN otherwise); there is no reset and no trace-out
derivation: A register left in |1> by toggle cannot be re-prepared to different bits: prepare and free both answer E_QREG_NOT_CLEAN until a run reverses or measures it.
